snippet.title: CULTIC - Console Release Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
CULTIC mixes lethal combat with immersive, survival horror to create a violently satisfying experience. Includes the original campaign, Interlude, the Chapter Two expansion campaign, all Survival maps, and the Cultmas bonus map.

Wishlist and Pre-Order Today: https://atari.com/products/cultic-complete-edition
